description: Curated subset of the most important events from 2017.json…2026.json for a highlights view. Full event objects copied verbatim (plus sourceFile); originals untouched.

events.title: Attention Is All You Need introduces the Transformer
events.summary: Ashish Vaswani et al. published arXiv:1706.03762 proposing the Transformer, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely and relying solely on multi-head self-attention plus positional encodings. It reached 28.4 BLEU on WMT14 English-German and 41.8 on English-French while training an order of magnitude faster due to parallelization. The 8-author paper (Vaswani, Shazeer, Parmar, Uszkoreit, Jones, Gomez, Kaiser, Polosukhin) became the architectural foundation for GPT, BERT, ViT, CLIP, AlphaFold and every large model after it.
events.significance: Year zero of the modern AI era. Every model from GPT-1 to GPT-5, Claude, Gemini and Llama is a direct descendant.

events.title: AlphaGo Zero masters Go without any human data
events.summary: DeepMind published AlphaGo Zero in Nature (announced Oct 18, 2017), training solely by self-play from random moves with a single neural network plus MCTS, no human games or handcrafted features. After 3 days it beat the Lee Sedol version 100-0, and after 40 days beat AlphaGo Master 89-11, discovering novel joseki humans now study. It removed the ceiling of human knowledge from training.
events.significance: Landmark proof that tabula-rasa superhuman learning works, generalizing later to AlphaZero and MuZero.

events.title: AlphaZero generalizes to chess, shogi and Go with one algorithm
events.summary: David Silver et al. posted arXiv:1712.01815 generalizing AlphaGo Zero into a single AlphaZero algorithm given only game rules. Within 24 hours from random play it beat Stockfish in chess and Elmo in shogi, and beat 3-day AlphaGo Zero in Go. Later published in Science on Dec 7, 2018 with GM analysis showing human-like positional sacrifices. It demonstrated a general-purpose RL algorithm could dominate multiple perfect-information domains.
events.significance: Shifted the field from narrow game engines to general RL agents, forerunner of MuZero and modern planning.

events.title: GDPR takes effect, reshaping AI data practices
events.summary: The General Data Protection Regulation was enforced, imposing consent, data minimization, right to explanation and erasure on AI training data scraping. events.significance: Regulatory backdrop for every later data lawsuit from 2023 onward.

events.title: BERT paper: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
events.summary: Jacob Devlin et al. posted arXiv:1810.04805 introducing Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers with masked LM plus next-sentence prediction, pretraining Base (110M) and Large (340M) on BooksCorpus plus Wikipedia (3.3B words) on 16 TPUs. Fine-tuned with one extra layer it pushed GLUE to 80.5 (+7.7), MultiNLI to 86.7% and SQuAD F1 to 93.2, beating humans on SQuAD. It made bidirectional pretraining dominant.
events.significance: Most influential NLP paper of 2018; briefly overtook GPT as the dominant paradigm.

events.title: AlphaFold wins CASP13 protein-folding competition
events.summary: At CASP13 in Cancun, AlphaFold placed first in free modeling, predicting 25 of 43 proteins with z-score 68.3 versus 48.2 for second place, using CNN distance distributions plus fragment assembly and gradient descent. First decisive deep-learning win on the 50-year protein-folding grand challenge, forerunner to AlphaFold 2 and the 2024 Nobel Prize.
events.significance: First sign AI could solve grand scientific challenges, not just games and language.

events.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
events.summary: Jared Kaplan et al. showed test loss scales as a smooth power-law in parameters, data and compute over 7+ orders of magnitude, with architecture shape mattering little. It established larger models are far more sample-efficient and compute-optimal training means training very large models. It directly motivated GPT-3 and the entire scale-up race.
events.significance: The engineer's handbook for the LLM race; cited in every scaling decision to 2024.
